deviations_for_delta_review: R4 probe expects memory 9 (its reference assumes the 8 unstored plays are 2025). The stored data cannot show when those plays happened; 9 would be invented. The repair keeps the song's totals (10) under a period rule, says the song is only partly covered, and lets the listener exclude it as a whole (totals rule) or re-import for an exact selection. Negative retained: 'expected 10 to be 9'.

Probe 'unknown owner playlist prevents claiming a definitive song count' sets owner_id NULL only in SQLite, then starts a count 2 h later: the count re-reads the stale (>10 min) playlist list from the provider, which reports the owner again, so the playlist is correctly own and the count complete. The provider-level variant ('unknown provider owner cannot create a definitive zero', owner null from Spotify) passes. Negative retained.
